description:
Browser where your favorite apps won't get buried in tabs.


🍪 Biscuit Release Note

💪🏻Improvements
- Added a back button to link previews so you can return to the previous page.
- Centered link previews within the page area, excluding the sidebar.

🐞Bug
- Fixed links that opened a new tab unexpectedly while browsing a link preview. Normal clicks now stay in the preview, while explicit new-tab actions and sign-in popups keep their usual behavior.
- Moved the loading message to a bottom-left overlay so preview content no longer shifts while loading.
